channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Trump claims direct talks with Iran: Is diplomacy picking up again?
item.description: The US president says Washington is 'hopefully toward the end' of Iran war, as global energy prices remain high.

item.title: At least 19 injured in Russian attacks across Ukraine
item.description: Missile and drone strikes targeted Ukraine's capital Kyiv as well as the Zaporizhzhia and Odesa regions.

item.title: ‘They called us’: Has Trump abandoned Bab al-Mandeb to the Houthis?
item.description: Washington’s response to the Houthi advance exposes the limits of the US security umbrella in the Gulf.

item.title: Ninth woman's body found as South African police investigate string of deaths
item.description: South Africa police have cautioned against assuming that all the killings are linked but many women are afraid.

item.title: Photos show widespread damage at US sites from Iranian attacks
item.description: A wrecked air force plane and destroyed buildings are among the images obtained by the BBC's partner CBS News.

item.title: Eight children among 21 killed after war-damaged Gaza building collapses, rescuers say
item.description: Some 10 families had reportedly been living in the six-storey building in Gaza City that was hit by an Israeli strike last year.

item.title: Saudi Arabia says it shot down Houthi drone south of Mecca
item.description: The Houthis deny targeting the Islamic holy city after the Saudi-led coalition in Yemen accuses them of a "disgraceful act".

item.title: Charlie Kirk's family alleges 'stunning failures' by Utah officials led to his shooting
item.description: The conservative activist was speaking to a crowd of thousands on the university campus when he was shot and killed by a gunman positioned on a roof.

item.title: Watch: Leaked photos reveal extensive damage at US bases in Gulf
item.description: The photos, provided by active military personnel, show a severed radar jet, flattened trailers and severely damaged buildings as a result of Iranian strikes.
